instruction: Count all slides in 'Dickinson_Slides.pptx' with LibreOffice Impress and record the total as the sole content of 'slide_count.docx' on your Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires counting the total number of slides in the PowerPoint presentation and saving the count to a Word document. Verified by reading the actual PowerPoint file: 9 slides total. The evaluator reads the Word document and extracts the number to verify it equals 9.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: counting slides and saving the count in a Word document
Getter logic is sound: reads the Word document from VM and extracts the first number found using flexible regex pattern
Metric logic is correct: compares extracted integer to expected count (9) with proper type checking
Expected value is accurate: 9 slides verified from actual PowerPoint file analysis
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (save slide count) and evaluator checks it
Good edge case handling: returns -1 if no number found, which metric correctly rejects
Flexible extraction: regex handles various formats like "9", "9 slides", "Total: 9"
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type=rule: directly accesses expected.get("expected_count")
